content_sections.heading: ASC Centre South Bangalore Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
ASC Centre South Bangalore Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 31 vacancies are available across four posts. All posts are open only to male candidates. Horizontal reservation includes 4% for Persons with Disability PWD, 10% for Ex-Servicemen ESM, and 5% for Meritorious Sports Persons MSP, at the discretion of the Appointing Authority. The notification states that PWD candidates have no vacancies under the Leading Fireman, Fire Engine Driver, or Librarian trades. The notification lists tentative station-wise vacancies for the Fireman, Leading Fireman, and Fire Engine Driver posts across various locations in India: Selected candidates are advised to give a choice of three stations in order of preference. All-India service liability applies, and candidates once selected may be required to serve in Hard Areas, High Altitude Areas, or Remote Locality Areas irrespective of the vacancy or unit against which they applied.

content_sections.heading: ASC Centre South Bangalore Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The age of candidates for Fireman, Leading Fireman, Fire Engine Driver, and Librarian must be between 18 and 25 years. SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against an unreserved post will not be given age or other concessions meant for their category. Age will be calculated as on the last date prescribed for receipt of application, based on the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation certificate. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date. Fireman, Leading Fireman, and Fire Engine Driver posts require candidates to be physically fit and pass a skill/endurance test: The notification does not specify a physical or endurance test for the Librarian post.
